hero.lead_html:
Whoever is ready to buy is the most valuable asset in real-estate. Achamos broadcasts your search through paid campaigns on Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube, connecting you with owners willing to sell — including those who haven't yet listed their properties.

While the market hunts for buyers, we make properties find you.

social.title: Real people, finding what they were looking for.
social.t1_q: "Moved from São Paulo looking for a penthouse in Flamengo. 6 months hunting alone — everything already sold. In 45 days, I got the keys to a penthouse never listed on any portal. R$ 200k below market."
social.t2_q: "First home for the family. Saw 30 properties on portals without closing. In 60 days I was in the kitchen of the new apartment — chosen among 3 candidates curated by the team."
social.t3_q: "I've lived in Ipanema for 30 years. Never thought about selling. Saw a post from We Found Properties looking for a 3-bed here. In 45 days it was sold — no sign on the window, no portal listing."

final_cta.lead_seller: First conversation is free. In 48h we tell you how many matching buyers we have.

methodology.lead_html: A property worth R$ 1M listed for R$ 2M on portals — that seller is not motivated, just hoping to get lucky. Our model flips the game: technology works for the buyer.
methodology.card_body_html: We have a buyer with R$ 1 million ready to pay cash for a property in Copacabana, 2 bedrooms, good condition.
methodology.card_cta: I have a property like this
methodology.b1_desc_html: Your search becomes a paid campaign on Instagram, Facebook and YouTube. Property owners — scrolling their feed all day — see there is a real buyer waiting.
methodology.b2_desc_html: Those who truly need to sell (health, investment, divorce) come to you, most of the time at a fair price, and in some cases with 20% to 50% discounts off the inflated portal price.
methodology.b3_desc_html: We earn commission from the seller, like any broker. The plans only fund the campaign — if we do not deliver, we refund most of it. In writing.
